glossary.title: Words used on the map
glossary.ontologyDefinition: An ontology records the important concepts in your business, what each means, and how they relate. The map connects those meanings to the code that implements them.
glossary.domainDefinition: A durable business responsibility and decision boundary that survives an implementation rewrite.
glossary.capabilityDefinition: An observable ability provided to people, agents, operators, or another system.
glossary.elementDefinition: A distinct implementation role that realizes or proves a capability, with evidence someone can open.
glossary.evidenceDefinition: Code or documents supporting a meaning claim. Check whether they support the definition and boundary, not just the label.
glossary.nodeNumberDefinition: Capabilities plus elements inside it: domains and documents are left out, so it is smaller than the concept total at the top
glossary.sharedConceptNote: A concept several domains reference is counted once, under the domain that holds it

criteria.project: one product or independently changeable system, with its purpose and boundary.
criteria.domain: a coherent business responsibility with its own language and boundaries. A folder or team alone is insufficient.
criteria.capability: a meaningful outcome the system can deliver. State who benefits, what happens, and its limits.
criteria.element: a concrete implementation unit that realizes a capability. Its code is evidence, not the business definition.
criteria.document: a source of context or evidence. Its existence alone does not establish a capability or an approved meaning.
criteria.vault-readme: A folder guide generated by the tooling. It is a reserved reader kind, outside the authorable kind choices.
criteria.unknown: The kind of this item is unknown, so no classification criterion has been applied.
